segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including one paired with eczema) describe it as non-oily, hydrating, and effective at improving acne without stripping.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, stinging, or burning, with several calling it gentle and calming and one noting relief from tightness and burning they had with a prior cleanser.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one in a desert climate and one on tretinoin, say it cleanses without drying out or tightening the skin and leaves it soft.
segments.mature: One 61-year-old reviewer with combination skin calls it a great, lightweight cleanser that does not dry out her skin, though she criticizes the packaging.

concerns.aging: One reviewer mentions using it alongside a nighttime serum and oil as part of an anti-aging-style routine, but no reviewer directly attributes wrinkle or firmness changes to the cleanser itself.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority report the cleanser leaves skin soft, moisturized, and not stripped, including for dry, hard-water, and desert conditions; no reviewer describes it as drying.
concerns.redness: A few sensitive-skin reviewers note it leaves skin smooth and calm with no reported redness or flare-ups.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer switching from a harsher cleanser reports her tightness and burning sensation stopped after switching to this product; others confirm no stinging even near the eyes.
concerns.spots: No reviewer specifically addresses dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: One acne-prone, very sensitive reviewer reports no increase in oiliness or breakouts and improved skin glow; another with sensitive combination skin reports her acne improved tremendously; no dissenting reports of breakouts appear.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with combination or oily-leaning skin describe the cleanser as non-oily and say it does not strip natural oils, leaving a balanced, non-greasy finish.
